hadith.title: In Light of Hadith
hadith.subtitle: The sayings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) about Qard al-Hasan

hadith1.text: Whoever takes people's wealth intending to repay it, Allah will repay it on his behalf. And whoever takes it intending to waste it, Allah will destroy him.

hadith2.text: Whoever takes a loan and does not intend to repay it, will meet Allah as a thief.

hadith3.text: All the sins of a martyr are forgiven except debt.
